statements.impact_statement: basic-ftp is a development dependency only (release-it > proxy-agent > pac-proxy-agent > get-uri > basic-ftp) and is not a dependency of any published package. In development, its FTP directory-listing parser is only reached when a proxy auto-config file is fetched over ftp://, which the release workflow never does.

basic-ftp is a development dependency only (release-it > proxy-agent > pac-proxy-agent > get-uri > basic-ftp) and is not a dependency of any published package. In development, Client.list() is only reached when a proxy auto-config file is fetched over ftp://; release-it uses the proxy agent only when github.proxy is set, and no configuration here sets it.
